meta.description: Parsa Derakhshan is a full-stack developer in Ottawa, building the Canadian Coast Guard's internal web applications in C#, .NET and Vue.

intro.p1: Since January 2022 I've been a programmer analyst at the Canadian Coast Guard, which moved from Fisheries and Oceans Canada to National Defence in September 2025. I build the internal web applications its staff rely on, mostly in C#/.NET and Vue, on SQL Server and Oracle.
intro.p2: Before that I was a data analyst intern at the Canadian Food Inspection Agency, and I studied Computer Engineering Technology at Algonquin College.
intro.photoAlt: Parsa sitting by the Ottawa River with Parliament Hill across the water
intro.photoCaption: On the Ottawa River, Parliament Hill behind me.

inkplusbot.title: InkPlusBot
inkplusbot.meta: 2024 to now · C#, EF Core, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker
inkplusbot.body: A Telegram bot for INK+, an Ottawa electronics repair shop with three locations. It looks up live inventory and repair tickets in the store's Lightspeed Retail system. It runs in Docker on Linux, with a WireGuard tunnel between the bot and the store's back end.

skiPatrol.title: Canadian Ski Patrol member system
skiPatrol.meta: 2023, college capstone · Java, Spring Boot, Hilla, Lit
skiPatrol.body: A college capstone that replaced the Canadian Ski Patrol's old Laravel/PHP member system, built for them as a real client. It has modules for events, training history, HR records and financial reports, each with a Java entity, a typed Hilla endpoint and a Lit view, and the interface is fully bilingual. It was handed to the Ski Patrol's contact, who deployed it to production.
skiPatrol.figureCaption: The real folder layout, trimmed: one backend package and one view per record type.

picross.title: Picross with multiplayer
picross.body: A nonogram game written in Java with a Swing interface, plus a client/server part so different players can connect and play. The grid below follows the same rules, if you want to try one.
picross.figureCaption: A 7 × 7 nonogram. Each number is a run of filled squares in that row or column, in order, with at least one gap between runs.

telegram.title: Telegram chat analysis
telegram.body: An analysis of an exported Telegram chat in Python: conversation patterns, how much each person takes part, and sentiment, drawn as charts with seaborn and matplotlib.

puzzle.label: Nonogram puzzle
puzzle.help: Click a square to fill it, click again to mark it empty, a third time to clear it.

experience.title: Experience

items.org: Canadian Coast Guard (Fisheries and Oceans Canada, now National Defence)
items.body: I designed the back end of ATONIS, the system that tracks Canada's buoys and other aids to navigation: a .NET 8 API using CQRS, an Entity Framework model that follows the IHO S-201 standard, and a GraphQL API that answers map questions (what is inside this area, what is near this point) and exports GeoJSON. On the front end I built its Vue and Leaflet map, where staff draw and edit areas directly. I also moved FS3 to a new Azure DevOps project with rebuilt pipelines, started bringing the 2007-era Fleet Safety System onto Razor Pages, and work on iPlan, the Pay Issue Portal, NTTT, PMIS and Activity Based Budgeting. Tests run from xUnit unit tests through integration tests against a real SQL Server to Selenium.

Wrote and tested Python scripts that automate the agency's yearly data update, built Power BI dashboards and analysis tools for researchers, and helped update the Comparative Risk Model with data gathered alongside Statistics Canada and other agencies.
Built the research group's website from the first design, working from what they asked for, then maintained the site and its database and added pages as needed, with every change tracked in Git.

experience.sqoAlt: The SQO group website: a dark red navigation bar above a photo of the research team in their lab

education.title: Education
